import numpy as np
from scipy import ndimage

_CLASS_IDS = tuple(range(1, 20))

def _nd(a, b):
    return (a - b) / np.maximum(a + b, 1e-6)

def label(x):
    \"\"\"Conservative visible-cover exclusions, not reconstructed CORINE labels.

    Input: unscaled reflectance DNs, shape (12, 120, 120).
    'no' for a water class means no spectrally resolved open water.
    No positive CORINE assignments are justified by these rules.
    \"\"\"
    x = np.asarray(x)
    if x.shape "'!= (12, 120, 120):
        raise ValueError("Expected shape (12, 120, 120).")
    if not np.issubdtype(x.dtype, np.number) or np.iscomplexobj(x):
        raise TypeError("Expected real numeric reflectance DNs.")
    out = {i: "abstain" for i in _CLASS_IDS}
    if not np.isfinite(x).all():
        return out
    r = x.astype(np.float64) / 10000.0
    if np.any(r < 0):
        return out

    # Do not clip high reflectances: they are useful quality flags.
    # B01 and B09 are coarse atmospheric bands, not texture measurements.
    blue, green, red = r[1], r[2], r[3]
    nir, narrow_nir, swir1, swir2 = r[7], r[8], r[10], r[11]
    visible = (blue + green + red) / 3.0
    ndvi = _nd(nir, red)
    ndwi = _nd(green, nir)
    mndwi = _nd(green, swir1)
    whiteness = (
        np.maximum.reduce([blue, green, red])
        - np.minimum.reduce([blue, green, red])
    ) / np.maximum(visible, 1e-6)

    # These are suspicion masks, not a replacement for SCL/cloud masks.
    cloud = (visible > 0.20) & (whiteness < 0.30)
    snow = (green > 0.12) & (mndwi > 0.40)
    dark = (visible < 0.025) & (nir < 0.05)
    suspect = cloud | snow | dark | np.any(r > 1.2, axis=0)
    if suspect.any():
        return out

    # Strong vegetation or SWIR-bright, clearly non-water surfaces.
    # Require agreement with the independent narrow-NIR band.
    vegetation = (
        (ndvi > 0.45) & (_nd(narrow_nir, red) > 0.45)
        & (nir > 0.15) & (swir1 > 0.06)
    )
    dry_surface = (
        (swir1 > 0.18) & (swir2 > 0.12) & (nir > 0.22)
        & (ndwi < -0.25) & (mndwi < -0.30)
    )
    nonwater = vegetation | dry_surface

    # Edge and local spectral variation make exclusions less reliable.
    # This is a 30 m neighborhood statistic, not subpixel information.
    mean = ndimage.uniform_filter(ndwi, size=3, mode="reflect")
    variance = np.maximum(
        ndimage.uniform_filter(ndwi * ndwi, size=3, mode="reflect")
        - mean * mean, 0.0
    )
    uncertain_edge = np.sqrt(variance) > 0.12

    # No percentage cutoff: even one unresolved pixel retains abstention.
    # Never split detected water into inland/marine from color or patch edges.
    if np.all(nonwater) and not uncertain_edge.any():
        out[18] = "no"
        out[19] = "no"
    return out

if __name__ == "__main__":
    patches = np.load("sample_bands.npy")
    predictions = [label(p) for p in patches]
    assert all(set(p) == set(range(1, 20)) for p in predictions)
    assert all(v in {"yes", "no", "abstain"} for p in predictions for v in p.values())
    for i in range(1, 20):
        print(i, {s: sum(p[i] == s for p in predictions) for s in ("yes", "no", "abstain")})
    for value in (0.0, float("nan"), 10000.0):
        assert set(label(np.full((12, 120, 120), value)).values()) == {"abstain"}
    print("Runtime, output-contract, and quality-guard checks passed.")

    if not np.isfinite(x).all():
        return out
    r = x.astype(np.float64) / 10000.0
    if np.any(r < 0):
        return out

    cloud = (visible > 0.20) & (whiteness < 0.30)

    dark = (visible < 0.025) & (nir < 0.05)

        (ndvi > 0.45) & (_nd(narrow_nir, red) > 0.45)

    )

        (swir1 > 0.18) & (swir2 > 0.12) & (nir > 0.22)
        & (ndwi < -0.25) & (mndwi < -0.30)
